## 主张 Claim

在 RelationalRenewal 的支持门控定律中，共同条件由依存于它的维持者更新。让焦点形成在共同条件支持它时依存于它，否则依存于一个支持它的替代条件，读作依存可变的依存网；共同条件的水平仍由原定律给出。若焦点形成从一开始就超出更新地汲取，则：它每一步都活跃；它对共同条件的依存在一个可以找到的步上消解，对替代条件的依存同时形成；它在运行中是消耗的（整段读法；这几乎由定义给出：ConsumingIn 只要求曾汲取一个被消耗的条件）；维持者从某步起永久失去支持并终止。一个具体定律（extracting）满足全部前提；在其中，逐步读法除第 2 步（共同条件跌破维持者的支持）外都记入它：越过之前它的汲取使每个所需仍被满足，越过之后它在模型中不汲取任何条件。在另一定律（slow）中，共同条件跌破维持者的支持之后仍支持焦点形成一步，它在第 2、3 步都被扣下：被扣下的是维持者失去支持之后、它转向替代条件之前的各步（一般情形为论证，未形式化）。对可判定的规定，停止成立的那一步可以找到。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / In RelationalRenewal's support-gated law, a shared condition is renewed by a sustaining formation that depends on it. Let the focal formation depend on the shared condition while it supports the focal formation and otherwise on an alternative that does, read as a web whose dependence changes; the shared condition's levels are still given by the law. If the focal formation draws beyond renewal from the start, then it is active at every step; its dependence on the shared condition dissolves, and one on the alternative forms, at a step that can be found; it is consuming in the run (on the whole-run reading, nearly by definition: ConsumingIn asks only for one draw on a consumed condition); and the sustaining formation loses support for ever from some step and ends. A concrete law (extracting) meets every premise; in it the stepwise reading credits the focal formation at every step except step 2, where the shared condition falls below the sustaining formation's support: before the crossing its draws leave every need met, and after it it draws on nothing in the model. In another law (slow) the shared condition still supports the focal formation for a step after it fails the sustaining formation, and the focal formation is withheld at steps 2 and 3: what is withheld are the steps after the sustaining formation loses support and before the focal formation switches (in general an argument, not formalized). With a decidable determination, the step at which it ceases can be found. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Substitution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Substitution.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 支持门控定律的前提：维持者与焦点形成的所需都为正，焦点所需不超过维持者所需，起点支持焦点形成，并且每步汲取都超出更新与贡献之和。 / The premises of the support-gated law: both needs are positive, the focal need does not exceed the sustaining need, the start supports the focal formation, and every step's draw exceeds renewal plus contribution.
- 按支持选择依存，是把“能替代”写进模型：这是建模选择，不是结论。替代条件的水平不变，汲取替代条件的代价没有建模。 / Choosing dependence by support writes the ability to substitute into the model: a modelling choice, not a conclusion. The alternative's level is constant, and the cost of drawing on it is not modelled.

在整段读法下替代保持分类，这几乎由 ConsumingIn 的存在式定义给出：一个以转化依存的方式熬过它参与造成的损失的形成，仍然是消耗的；它自身的持续不证明更新。这也是“赢的元吸引子”的一个结构：靠消耗取胜的一方可以转向别处而持续，失去者不随之恢复。在逐步读法下分类不保持：这样的胜者在维持者失去支持之前被记入，此后到它转向别处为止被扣下（extracting 中一步，slow 中两步）。“替代不证明更新”仍成立，因为逐步的 living 不是更新。一个实际形成能否替代、以什么代价，是应用义务。 / On the whole-run reading substitution preserves the classification, nearly by the existential definition of ConsumingIn: a formation that survives a loss it took part in by transforming its dependence still consumes, and its own continuation does not certify renewal. This is one structure of the meta-attractor of winning: one who wins by consumption can turn elsewhere and persist while the loser does not recover. On the stepwise reading the classification is not preserved: such a winner is credited before the sustaining formation loses support and withheld from then until it switches (one step in extracting, two in slow). “Substitution does not certify renewal” still holds, because stepwise living is not renewal. Whether an actual formation can substitute, and at what cost, is an application duty.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

替代条件有代价且都不被更新时，替代链终结，已由 unceasing-generation-needs-renewal 证明；替代条件被更新时消耗是否转移到别处，以及在依存可变的一般定律中陈述同样的保持，仍开放。 / That the chain of substitutions ends when the alternatives cost and none is renewed is proved in unceasing-generation-needs-renewal; whether consumption moves elsewhere when alternatives are renewed, and the same preservation for general laws with changing dependence, remain open.
